name: Programming
description: Odysseus's coding tools: a live Terminal on the server and the Claude Code sessions on this host, read like chats.
author: Jaron Wilson

steps.title: A shell on this server
steps.body:
The **Terminal** tab is a live command line on this server, as the user Odysseus runs as. Use it to run commands, `ssh` to other machines or start `claude`.

Each shell is a tab inside it (**+** opens another). A shell keeps running when you reload or lose the connection, and comes back with its recent output; closing its tab ends it.

steps.title: Copy, paste and phones
steps.body:
Select text and press **Ctrl+C** (or **Ctrl+Shift+C**) to copy it; **Ctrl+V** pastes. Right-click for Copy, Paste and Select all.

On a phone, the **Keys** row gives you Esc, Tab, Ctrl, Alt and the arrows.

steps.title: Read your Claude Code sessions
steps.body:
The **Claude sessions** tab lists every Claude Code session on this host, live ones first, and shows one like a chat: your prompts, Claude's replies and each tool call. Live sessions update by themselves.

**Copy /claude attach** copies the command that hands a session to a chat's coding agent.

steps.title: Limits and copy on select
steps.body: In settings, choose how many terminals can be open at once, how long one nobody is attached to keeps running, and whether selecting text copies it.
